Overview

L9 Director Media Analytics

What you'll be doing

The Marketing and Client Solutions Decision Sciences ( Growth) team is at the center of our Media

practice, strategy and innovation at CIBC. Its sole focus is to efficiently drive growth in reach and

conversions through efficient media investments that are data driven. We work across different

enterprise teams at CIBC and Simplii helping them understand and serve our clients and Canadians

better each day. We apply best practices in marketing measurement, descriptive and predictive analysis,

machine learning, artificial intelligence and leverage the latest in big data technology platforms.

Reporting into the COE Lead for Marketing and Client solutions within AI Data and Analytics, this role is

responsible for leading a Media decision sciences practice, delivering on strategic priorities, managing

and maintaining team operations and senior stakeholder relationships, equipping the Media Ops teams

with high quality and timely data and insights to continuously optimize our Media. This Director will

lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on

approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing

sciences delivery.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role you’ll have the

flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days

per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You Will Succeed

Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to

marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media

measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and

aligned to business outcomes.

Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee

the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn

programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and

emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign

performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.

Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology

through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business

needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.

Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media

analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen,

and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business

priorities and enterprise goals.

Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design,

data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to

relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners

across the organization.

Who You Are

You are a media analytics leader first — You bring strong command of the media landscape and

understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You

are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.

You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking — You know how to move from business

question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping

measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment

decisions.

You are highly analytical and experimentally minded — You have deep experience applying

advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal

measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous

experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.

You are digitally and technically fluent — You are comfortable working with modern analytics and

data science tools such as Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and cloud-based data environments. You can

partner effectively with technical teams while staying focused on business relevance and usability.

You are an effective translator between technical and business teams — You can turn complex

analytical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders. You know how to influence

decisions, build trust, and bring partners along in environments with complexity and ambiguity.

You are a strong people leader — You lead with clarity, accountability, and empathy. You develop

talent, elevate team capability, and create an inclusive environment where high performance and

collaboration go hand in hand.

You understand applied AI in a marketing context — You have experience using traditional AI/ML

techniques and an appreciation for where GenAI can enhance workflows, insight generation, and

decision support. You are thoughtful about where these tools add value and where rigor in

measurement must remain paramount.

You bring strong business and industry judgment — Experience in marketing, media, or sales

analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate

in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.

You are well-credentialed and credible — You bring advanced academic training in analytics,

statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a

track record of delivering large, high-impact analytical initiatives.

About Citco

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About The Group & Team

The Transformation Office Process Design team aims to improve quality and efficiency across Citco Fund Services (CFS) through a combination of process re-design and process deep dives to help transform our organization’s processes. We conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses on business operations to identify improvement opportunities and implement solutions through workshops, analysis and technology expertise. Our team, a subgroup of the Transformation Office, is tasked with project and workshop execution, challenging processes and identifying global change, and reporting to Transformation Office and Business executive teams. In addition to leading the execution of key strategic initiatives, we are commonly expected to facilitate engagement sessions, conduct analyses, and produce succinct reporting to senior leadership

Responsibilities

Your Role

The Transformation Office is looking for an experienced Senior Project Delivery Lead (Vice President) to lead our most complex, ambiguous and high-visibility process and organizational design engagements, and to provide oversight, coaching and quality assurance to engagements led by Project Delivery Leads (Managers) when required.

We are seeking a senior design and facilitation leader who can influence senior leaders, set the direction and quality bar for engagements, and coach the Managers and BAs who deliver them, while staying connected enough to the work to assure quality and direction. About The Opportunity

Our client, is seeking an experienced and technically driven Director of Development and Planning
to lead the planning, feasibility assessment, design development, budgeting and coordination of its real estate development projects.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO) and working closely with the Director of Construction, the successful candidate will oversee projects from initial conception through construction and completion. This role requires a strong technical background in architecture, engineering, construction management or a related discipline, combined with extensive experience managing residential and multifamily real estate development projects.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong financial and project management capabilities who can coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage complex budgets and ensure projects are delivered efficiently, on schedule and in accordance with established quality standards.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Lead development planning, project evaluations and feasibility assessments, including zoning requirements, site constraints, servicing capacity, construction costs and financial viability
Establish preliminary development budgets, project schedules, key milestones and development strategies
Oversee architects, engineers, urban planners, surveyors and other professional consultants throughout the design and development process
Coordinate architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical and civil engineering plans to ensure design accuracy, constructability and cost efficiency
Oversee municipal approvals, zoning applications, site plan approvals and building permit processes
Prepare, manage and monitor comprehensive development and construction budgets, identifying variances, potential cost overruns and opportunities for savings
Collaborate with the Director of Construction on tendering, subcontractor and supplier selection, procurement, purchase orders and contractual requirements
Monitor construction progress, schedules, milestones, quality standards and overall project performance in collaboration with the Director of Construction
Review change orders, trade performance, construction deficiencies and potential cost impacts
Review monthly construction draw reports, invoices, purchase orders, progress claims and supporting financial documentation
Monitor project expenditures, committed costs and forecasts to ensure accurate financial reporting and cost control
Prepare regular project status reports, development schedules, budget updates and recommendations for senior management
Identify and escalate project risks, delays, budget discrepancies and other issues requiring management attention
Coordinate project completion, occupancy approvals and closeout activities
Maintain effective communication and collaboration with the COO, Director of Construction, finance team, consultants, contractors, lenders and other stakeholders

About You

The successful candidate will have the following:

A strong educational background or professional training in architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, construction engineering, construction management or a related technical discipline
A university degree or college diploma in a relevant technical field is strongly preferred
10-15 years of relevant experience in real estate development, construction project management, architectural or engineering coordination, or related project delivery functions
Demonstrated experience managing complex residential or multifamily development projects from initial planning through construction
Strong understanding of architectural and engineering drawings, construction methods, building systems, municipal approval processes and construction budgeting
Proven experience coordinating multidisciplinary professional teams, consultants, general contractors and subcontractors
Demonstrated ability to prepare, manage and monitor multimillion-dollar development and construction budgets
Experience with tendering, procurement, purchase orders, construction contracts, change orders and financial reporting
Strong knowledge of project scheduling, cost controls, construction draws and cost-to-complete forecasting
Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, communication and leadership skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project management software
Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, MS Project or similar technical software is considered an asset
Experience with Ontario and/or Québec municipal planning, building approvals and regulatory requirements is considered a strong asset
Bilingualism in English and French is considered an asset

About the Job

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a senior leadership role with direct involvement in the planning, financial management and execution of residential and multifamily real estate development projects.

Compensation Package:

Annual base salary starting from $100,000 commensurate with qualifications and experience
Eligibility for quarterly performance-based bonuses, subject to the Company's established bonus program
Performance bonuses may be assessed based on project milestones, budget management, municipal approvals, procurement performance, construction coordination, financial reporting and overall project execution

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to play a key role in the Company's development activities while working closely with senior management and construction leadership.
